flaky_resize_diagnostics.interpretation: The original failed attempt naturally returned width 600 after its outer five-second poll had already failed. The resize was not permanently lost in that attempt. The trace does not isolate ResizeObserver dispatch, rendering, browser scheduling or IPC cost, and this old test did not assert the height.
flaky_resize_diagnostics.source_review: main.ts resize synchronously assigns scene.resize() dimensions to diagnostics; the periodic two-second metrics update is not responsible for publishing width/height. No application resize change was made for this finding.

observations: No concrete new control clipping, overlap, missing scene region or broad recovery-lighting darkening was visible in the five inspected captures.
Restored night visibly shows Cedar crossing, Saved on this device, Night selected and 0 mm/s.
Before/after recovery composition and lighting appear consistent; the restored status reads The railway is ready again.
All four joint panels and their labels render; visible central rail profiles appear continuous at this resolution.
Overview/recovery framing crops the upper case lid. Joint closeups crop rail ends; those excluded portions are not inspected.
independent_capture_review.scope: Archived desktop captures only; not pixel-equivalence measurement, motion assessment, native/physical-device proof, production-art approval or a claim about the flaky resize case.
